For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference. Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact. We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together. Job Description MARGO Background: The MARGO function is part of the wider Medical Affairs Research (MAR) department within the Development organization and operationalises Non Interventional Studies scientifically led from MAR. MAR conducts observational research and generates analysis results to inform decisions throughout the product lifecycle across research, development, post-approval, and commercialization. Observational research is conducted on data collected from individuals assessed for biomedical, health and other outcomes, and includes observational studies and observational analyses. Source data for observational studies may be based on primary data collection, secondary data use, or both. The study results, generated using a rigorous process, provide insights and evidence for internal (e.g., program, safety) and external (e.g., regulators, healthcare providers) stakeholders. Position Summary: This role provides end-to-end operational oversight of observational studies within the MAR portfolio across all therapeutic areas (TA). This position supports the MAR team in high-quality, compliant and timely study execution of the study portfolio through effective vendor oversight, risk management and issue resolution. This role reports to the Director, MAARGO and is the primary point of contact for study operations for vendors and service providers. While not responsible for day-to-day execution, the role is responsible for collaborating with MAR scientific leads, Quality, Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Medical Affairs and other stakeholders to ensure vendors and service providers meet agreed-upon timelines and are compliant with process requirements and relevant regulatory guidelines. Quality for guidance and consultation Qualifications: • Previous experience in study operations or project management providing operational and financial oversight of observational studies • BS degree About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
We're seeking a business development lead to own Anthropic's BD partnership footprint with a small number of the world's largest and most consequential technology companies. These are not single-threaded accounts. Each relationship spans many businesses at once — consumer products, devices and operating systems, productivity and collaboration software, cloud and developer platforms, commerce, and enterprise distribution. Your job is to see the whole board, decide where Anthropic should lean in and where it shouldn't, and turn that judgment into signed deals.
The center of gravity for this role is product and distribution partnerships: co-developing opportunities with partners, and structuring the commercial, technical, and go-to-market terms that make those partnerships durable. You'll typically be running several deal streams inside the same partner in parallel — at different stages, with different counterparts, and with terms that interact with one another — and you'll be the person responsible for keeping them coherent.
This is an individual contributor role for a seasoned dealmaker who is comfortable as the primary counterpart to senior executives at very large companies, who brings strong judgment to ambiguous, high-stakes situations, and who can carry a complex, multi-party negotiation from first conversation through signature and into execution.
Key responsibilities
Manage a small number of large, multi-faceted partner relationships end to end: set the strategy for each relationship, decide which opportunities to pursue and in what order, and stay accountable for the overall health and commercial output of the partnership across every surface it touches
Lead product partnerships: identify and structure opportunities to embed Claude in partners' consumer and enterprise products, co-develop new products and features, and define the product, technical, data, and brand terms that come with them, working closely with Anthropic's product and engineering leaders
Run multiple deal streams in parallel: manage several concurrent negotiations within the same partner — product integrations, distribution and go-to-market, commercial and consumption agreements, and infrastructure — and sequence and connect them so terms in one stream reinforce rather than undercut the others
Negotiate complex, first-of-kind agreements: lead end-to-end negotiations involving novel commercial structures, revenue and economics sharing, product and roadmap commitments, exclusivity and competitive provisions, data terms, and multi-year, multi-component value exchanges
Act as an executive counterpart: build and manage relationships with senior executives and their teams on the partner side, serve as Anthropic's primary voice into the partnership, and prepare and steer Anthropic's own executives through partner-level engagements
Exercise judgment on behalf of Anthropic: weigh commercial upside against strategic, competitive, product, and mission considerations; know when to say no; and make clear, well-reasoned recommendations to Anthropic leadership on trade-offs that don't have a playbook
Drive cross-functional execution: coordinate Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Policy across the life of a partnership, from initial structuring through negotiation, launch, and ongoing governance, ensuring what we sign is something Anthropic can deliver
Minimum qualifications
Direct experience owning a large, multi-business partner relationship, where you were responsible for the whole relationship rather than a single deal or product line
Track record of structuring and closing product partnerships — embedding technology into partner products, co-developed products, distribution through partner surfaces, or similar — in addition to conventional commercial agreements
Experience personally leading complex, multi-stakeholder negotiations with senior executives, including deals with interlocking terms, competitive sensitivities, and multi-year commitments
Demonstrated ability to manage several significant negotiations at the same time without losing the thread on any of them
Experience coordinating cross-functional execution (e.g., Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance) to bring a complex agreement from structuring through signature and delivery
Preferred qualifications
10+ years in strategic business development, strategic partnerships, or corporate development at technology companies, with meaningful time spent managing relationships with very large technology partners
Experience on either side of a partnership between a foundation model or AI platform provider and a large technology company
Experience working inside one of the very large technology companies, with a practical understanding of how decisions get made, who holds budget and roadmap authority, and how to navigate them
Experience with partnerships that span both consumer and enterprise businesses, or that combine product, distribution, and infrastructure components in a single relationship
Understanding of foundation model capabilities and how they translate into partner products, with enough technical fluency to work credibly with product and engineering leaders on both sides
Background in corporate development, strategy, or a legal or finance discipline involving structuring and papering unusually complex agreements

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

THE ROLE: As a Senior Program Manager in Data Center CSP Program Management, you will lead end-to-end execution of AMD's Cloud Service Provider (CSP) data center GPU programs — from contract and site kickoff through build, deployment, go-live, and sustaining operations. This role owns the operational discipline behind a multi-billion-dollar portfolio of CSP and Managed Data Center engagements spanning site readiness and energization, rack build and validation, customer handover, fleet health, and capacity pipeline planning. Partnering across Engineering, Business Development, Product Management, Supply Chain, OEM/ODM partners, and CSP customers, you will plan requirements, drive schedules, manage risk, and deliver the governance, reporting, and executive visibility that keep large-scale GPU deployments on track. Customer Deployment & Handover: Manage cluster build, validation, burn-in, acceptance criteria, and customer handover; coordinate AMD, OEM/ODM, and CSP teams to hit go-live commitments and close handover risk. Fleet Health & Issue Management: Govern nodes-in-service, RMA, field failure, and open-issue tracking across the deployed fleet; drive prioritization, root-cause closure, and recovery plans with engineering, platform, software, and supply chain teams, and hold owners accountable to closure dates. Capacity Pipeline & Planning: Lead the forward capacity pipeline — standardizing provider submissions into a unified capacity data model, scoring and tiering opportunities on readiness (power secured, land control, permits, design, financing, construction, provider confidence), and publishing a governed, risk-adjusted view of multi-gigawatt capacity by site, year, and quarter. Reporting, Dashboards & Automation: Build and operationalize executive reporting — status dashboards, utilization and issue metrics, and pipeline views in Power BI, SharePoint, and internal CSP systems — eliminating manual consolidation and replacing spreadsheet sprawl with automated, governed data flows. Stakeholder & Executive Communication: Serve as the primary program contact across Engineering, Business Development, Product Management, Supply Chain, Operations, and IT; run status reviews, drive cross-functional decisions, and present progress, risks, and tradeoffs to senior leadership and customers with precision and clarity. Governance & Process Improvement: Establish and sustain consistent program governance — intake, prioritization, planning, change management, reporting cadence, and escalation paths — across Waterfall, Agile, and hybrid delivery models, and continuously improve the process through automation and analytics. Risk Management: Proactively identify risks, execution gaps, and systemic bottlenecks across supply, schedule, technical readiness, and partner performance; build and drive mitigation and recovery plans. Scopely is looking for a
Marketing Intelligence & AI Automation Manager
to join our creative Intelligence team working in our Barcelona studio on a hybrid basis.
At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.
Creative Intelligence, a central team within Performance Marketing, is responsible for creating the tools and analyzing the results of our creative data to improve our marketing and UA strategy across our entire game portfolio.
What You Will Do
This hands-on individual contributor role requires marketing and analytical thinking, technical curiosity, and comfort solving ambiguous problems. You will be responsible for:
Marketing Intelligence and Reporting
Use Codex, Claude, Looker MCP, Big Data, and other tools to automate monthly performance reporting, competitive analysis, and benchmarking
Translate complex creative and marketing data into clear, executive-ready insights, recommendations, and actions
Proactively identify reporting and analysis gaps and recommend new solutions that enable better creative decision-making
Partner with stakeholders to prioritize the most valuable business questions and continuously improve reporting
Data Access, Partnership, and Quality Assurance
Identify, connect to, and query the internal and external data sources needed to answer key business questions
Understand the schemas, metrics, dimensions, and fields available through Looker MCP, Big Data, and other connected sources
Validate AI-generated outputs and establish quality controls to ensure insights are complete, accurate, and supported by data
Identify data gaps, inconsistencies, and metric issues, resolving them independently where possible or translating them into actionable requests for Marketing Analytics
AI Automation and Enablement
Identify inefficient or manual workflows and recommend where AI, automation, or other tools can deliver meaningful value, all while ensuring solutions follow company standards for data privacy, security, governance, and responsible AI use
Build scalable AI workflows, agents, prompts, templates, data connections, and reporting processesEvaluate emerging AI capabilities and proactively recommend the
most effective tools and use cases for the Creative Intelligence team
Document effective workflows and help the broader team adopt AI through practical guidance and training
What We’re Looking For
We are looking for an AI-forward marketing intelligence professional to join our Creative Intelligence team and automate recurring reporting, competitive analysis, and insight generation using tools such as Codex and Claude. We are looking for someone who has:
Experience using AI tools such as Codex or Claude to build reports, automations, agents, or internal workflows
Experience connecting to and querying data using SQL, APIs, MCP connections, or similar methods
Familiarity with Looker, data schemas, and business intelligence environments
Experience translating marketing performance or competitive data into clear insights and actionable recommendations
Strong analytical and business judgment, including the ability to validate AI-generated outputs and recognize what the data may be missing
Comfortable working independently through ambiguity and proactively identifying problems and opportunities
Creative, curious, and resourceful, with a focus on developing practical, scalable solutions
Strong cross-functional communication skills and the ability to partner effectively with Marketing Analytics and nontechnical stakeholders
Strong English language skills are required for this role as we have a highly diverse and global business
At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. jobs.description: Amazon Web Services is seeking a senior marketing leader to define and execute the marketing strategy for India — one of the fastest-growing and most strategically important markets in the Asia Pacific region. This is a player/coach role: you will set the long-term marketing direction for India while staying deeply connected to execution across demand generation, Account-Based Marketing (ABM), events, digital marketing, and public relations. As the Head of Marketing for India, you will be the single-threaded owner of marketing strategy, planning, and campaign execution targeting startups, developers, digital natives, SMBs, enterprises, and public sector customers across India. You will lead and develop a high-performing regional marketing team, drive orchestration across global marketing functions — including the Integrated Demand Centre (IDC), digital marketing, and events (Flagship and Cohort) — and deliver locally resonant programs that accelerate customer acquisition, pipeline growth, and brand awareness. You will partner closely with the India sales leadership team, cross-functional marketing leaders across Asia Pacific & Japan (APJ), and global corporate teams to ensure marketing programs are tightly aligned to business priorities and deliver measurable impact. The ideal candidate combines strategic vision with executional rigor, has a proven track record of building and scaling marketing functions in India's technology landscape, and brings a genuine passion for cloud technology and an entrepreneurial mindset. Key job responsibilities • Create compelling, results-driven marketing plans, complete with market assessments that deliver identified objectives to the business • Overseeing implementation of the Marketing strategy for India - including campaigns, events, digital marketing, and PR. • Lead overall implementation of marketing programs including lead generation activities, eMarketing campaigns, product & solutions sales support, reference programs, customer & developer marketing programs, etc. • Organize, assist and implement marketing events, including the AWS Summits, exhibitions, seminars, tradeshows and product launches. • Day to day management and development of the marketing team. • Work closely with the company’s Sales team; enabling them to meet their commercial objectives by providing them with appropriate tools, materials and presentations. • Develop and execute customer-driven, locally oriented marketing strategies and programs that will increase customer demand, sales, and positively impact Amazon Web Services brand equity. A day in the life The Head of Marketing for India will be responsible for building and executing marketing plans that deliver customer acquisition and retention programs necessary to power AWS's continued growth in India. The role's core responsibility is to use a combination of strong strategic planning and hands-on execution skills to successfully plan, develop, execute, and measure demand generation programs that deliver marketing contribution to the sales pipeline. You will operate at the intersection of strategy and action — setting the quarterly roadmap in the morning, reviewing campaign performance data over lunch, and joining a customer event debrief in the afternoon. No two days look the same, and that's what makes this role exciting.
